query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('source_pages', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 724 AND 728), 'topics', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics WHERE slug IN ('united-nations-membership-boundary-724','united-nations-institutions-boundary-725','united-nations-policy-boundary-726','united-nations-peacekeeping-boundary-727','bangladesh-united-nations-boundary-728')), 'facts', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 724 AND 728), 'notes', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 724 AND 728), 'mcqs', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 724 AND 728), 'verifications', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 724 AND 728), 'flashcards', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0724-0728:%'), 'search_documents', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE (d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 724 AND 728)) OR (d.entity_type='note' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 724 AND 728)) OR (d.entity_type='mcq' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 724 AND 728)))) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
